description: Class representing a collection of pivot filters applied to a pivot field.

Add.description:
Adds a new filter to the pivot field. This method is VBA-compatible and follows the PivotFilters.Add signature from Excel VBA.
Supports all major filter types including label filters, value filters, top/bottom filters, and date filters.

params.description: The type of filter to add. Must match VBA XlPivotFilterType enum values.
params.name: filterType

params.description: The data field object to filter by. Required for value filters (xlValue* types) and top/bottom filters.
params.name: dataField

params.description: The first value for the filter condition. Required for comparison, between, and top/bottom count filters.
params.name: value1

params.description: The second value for "Between" conditions (xlCaptionIsBetween, xlCaptionIsNotBetween, xlValueIsBetween).
params.name: value2

params.description: Specifies whether to filter by whole day for date filters. Reserved for future use, currently not implemented.
params.name: wholeDayFilter

Add.signature: Add(filterType: XlPivotFilterType, dataField?: ApiPivotDataField, value1?: string | number | Date, value2?: string | number | Date, wholeDayFilter?: boolean): void
